# Security reports

To report a suspected security vulnerability in Yado, email [hi@yado.house](mailto:hi@yado.house) with the app version and the steps to reproduce it. Send security details privately rather than posting them in a public issue or discussion.

## 安全问题

发现 Yado 的安全问题，可以把 App 版本和复现步骤发到 [hi@yado.house](mailto:hi@yado.house)，问题详情走邮件，不发到公开 Issue 或讨论里。
